reason: I pay for nothing right now and my family's money for this kind of thing is tight. Everything the Pro part promises, like mentor hints and resume tools, I can get free on YouTube, GeeksforGeeks and my free chatbot.
objection: Nothing I have read says the paid part does something free tools cannot. An AI mentor that only gives hints sounds like extra work, not a better result.
would_change_my_mind: A checked result I could not get anywhere else, such as my code proven against hidden tests on a real placement-style problem.
